message: 見えかた
Saturday in the Student Council room.
The council officers had each shown up whenever they felt like it, worked through their duties at their own pace, and headed home.
Nanaka was invited out by Sacchin, Lolotte went to eat with Riesling, and Misa said she had plans with Shio.
Left alone, I keep making revisions to the draft proposal for our meeting.

name: Misasagi
message: 「President, the tea is ready?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, what amazing concentration. He hasn't even noticed we stopped by to visit.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I bet he didn't notice Ria coming back for something she forgot and crossing paths with me either.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Please have a cup as well, Chairwoman. Though my tea-making doesn't come anywhere close to my younger sister's.」

name: Helena
message: 「Gulp... Oh, this is very delicious, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm glad it was palatable.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Though I do have my own strong opinions on Japanese sweets, I only ever learned the tea ceremony as a matter of etiquette.」

name: Helena
message: 「As long as it tastes good, that's plenty. The flavor of tea changes constantly depending on how you're feeling that day, after all.」

name: Helena
message: 「Tea, sweets, and the 'Way' of tea... It's that 'Way' part that makes things tricky.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Indeed. When simply enjoying the craft would be fine enough... turning it into a 'Way' just makes everything so complicated.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The 'Way'... Even when you understand it, it's still a difficult thing.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, come on, you actually understand it just fine, don't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「To put it logically... Let's see, that whiteboard over there always looks white whenever you look at it.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Isn't that only natural?」

name: Helena
message: 「Not necessarily, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「That board has been there since back when I was the active Student Council President. After so many years, it ought to have yellowed a bit.」

name: Helena
message: 「And yet, to me, it still feels white.」

name: Helena
message: 「The sunlight streaming through the windows changes with the seasons, and to be even more precise, the sun's path shifts little by little every single day, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yet to me, it always... morning, noon, or night, ends up looking the exact same shade of white. It makes me want to start jotting down agenda items right away.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「In other words... it's the same as Rii-a is to you, Headmistress?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. Forever childish and reckless... yet still my adorable little sister.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I do hope the President is the same way for you, Ria」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「*giggle*」

name: Helena
message: 「*hehe*」
